items.finding: The definition of Confidential Information is mutual, covering non-public information disclosed by either party.
items.quote: "Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by a Party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other Party (the "Receiving Party") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential

items.finding: Obligations to maintain confidentiality, restrict access, and exercise reasonable care apply equally to both parties.
items.quote: The Receiving Party shall: (a) use the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information only for the Purpose; (b) disclose it only to its employees, directors, professional advisers and subcontractors who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less protective than this Agreement; (c) protect it with at least reasonable care and no less care than it applies to its own confidential information

items.finding: The agreement does not contain a residuals clause, nor does it grant implied licenses, leaving both parties' proprietary rights intact.
items.quote: Confidential Information remains the property of the Disclosing Party. No licence is granted except the limited right to use it for the Purpose.

items.finding: The remedies clause allows either party as a Disclosing Party to seek injunctive relief without disproportionate liabilities or indemnities.
items.quote: Each Party acknowledges that damages may not be an adequate remedy for breach, and the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive relief in addition to other remedies available at law.

items.finding: There are no restrictive covenants such as non-competes or non-solicits; clause 8.2 explicitly clarifies that parties remain free to work with third parties.
items.quote: Neither Party is obliged to enter into any further agreement. Each Party remains free to work with third parties, provided it does not use or disclose the other Party's Confidential Information.

items.finding: The agreement has a fixed term of 2 years, with confidentiality obligations surviving for a reasonable, fixed period of 3 years post-termination.
items.quote: This Agreement remains in force for two (2) years from the Effective Date. ... Each Party's obligations under Clauses 3 to 6 continue for three (3) years after expiry or termination of this Agreement.
